name: Great Salt Marshes
description: Caliphear's home swamp, being drained by Coldraith's enchantment.

timeline.summary: Caliphear finds her swamp dying and defeats an Azure Drake chasing Laconia; Laconia explains the raid and the draining enchantment.
timeline.quote: Since she is on her own ground, Caliphear easily defeats the Drake.

citation.text: "Nightmare (comic)", section "Meeting Altair". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: With Coldraith dead his spells break and the Torrent flows again; Altair confirms he will serve Caliphear for ten years.
timeline.quote: Altair remembers his promise and confirms his intention to be her servant for ten years.
